description: Fix confirmed indexing and cross-reference bugs that prevent accurate symbol/import/dependency data, which degrade token-saving quality for consumers of the MCP tools.

stories.title: Fix resolveDependencyTargets Map collision: last-write-wins drops all but one symbol per name
acceptanceCriteria: resolveDependencyTargets builds a multi-value map (name→SymbolRecord[]) so that symbols with identical short names (e.g. 'constructor' in two classes) are all retained
When only one candidate exists for a name, d.toSymbolId is set correctly and d.resolution='resolved'
When multiple candidates exist, resolution prefers the symbol in the same file as the dependency location before falling back to the first candidate
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
npm test passes with all tests green

stories.title: Fix kindOf: VariableDeclaration nodes return 'unknown' instead of 'variable'
acceptanceCriteria: kindOf returns 'variable' for ts.VariableDeclaration nodes (addSym is called with individual declarations, not VariableStatement)
Variable symbols in the index have kind='variable', not kind='unknown'
resolve_symbol with kind='variable' filter returns const/let/var declarations
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
npm test passes with all tests green

stories.title: Fix resolveImport: .js ESM imports resolve to .js instead of .ts — all ImportRecord.resolvedPath values are wrong
acceptanceCriteria: resolveImport rewrites .js source suffix to .ts (and .jsx to .tsx) before path resolution, matching TypeScript ESM conventions
ImportRecord.resolvedPath for 'import ... from "./foo.js"' resolves to 'src/foo.ts' not 'src/foo.js'
Non-relative imports (no leading '.') still return null
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
npm test passes with all tests green

stories.title: Fix NewExpression not tracked: 'constructs' relationship is never recorded because new Foo() is not a CallExpression
acceptanceCriteria: A separate ts.isNewExpression(n) branch in visit() records relationship='constructs' with the constructed class name as reference
The dead-code check ref.startsWith('new ') in the CallExpression branch is removed
DependencyRecord with relationship='constructs' appears in the index when a symbol uses 'new ClassName()'
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
npm test passes with all tests green

stories.title: Fix reservePrimaryContext: required content can silently overrun budget without setting truncated=true
acceptanceCriteria: When required content causes consumedTokens to exceed requestedMaxTokens, b.truncated is set to true
budgetReport returns truncated:true whenever estimated_returned_tokens would exceed requested_max_tokens
Single required items that fit within the remaining budget still set truncated:false
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
npm test passes with all tests green

stories.title: Fix getSymbolContext: omitted_dependencies at depth=0 returns ALL deps as omitted — wastes tokens the caller did not ask for
acceptanceCriteria: When dependency_depth===0, omitted_dependencies is an empty array
When dependency_depth>0, omitted_dependencies correctly lists deps beyond the first 12 included ones
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
npm test passes with all tests green
